property_summary: For every caller and assertionId, calling assertionDisputedCallback on the correct contract reverts unless called by the optimistic asserter (onlyOptimisticAsserter), whereas the mutant removes this restriction allowing non-asserter callers to successfully call assertionDisputedCallback for some inputs; thus the reference always blocks external callers while the mutant sometimes permits them.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from assertionDisputedCallback so it can be called by any address, changing when assertionDisputedCallback can be invoked and thus its observed value.
